coverage_note: Full tree reviewed through public exports, Python class/run contracts, pipeline configuration and sensitive implementation surfaces. Retain the distribution, three concrete pipelines, reusable orchestration/trace/visualization, concrete image-processing/encoding/matching/aggregation algorithms and independently configurable quality gates. Two inference backends are alternatives. The model card is a model reference, not a claim that weights or training datasets are bundled or independently verified. Abstract interfaces, data/error classes, nested Parameters, enum values, arithmetic helpers, test fixtures and routine CI are implementation detail. The original five static detections were only workflows and missed the complete algorithm library.

dependencies: Pydantic IRIS algorithm parameters and data models
entity_defaults.overlap: A separately callable IRIS algorithm or subsystem. Compose through the package's IRImage/GeometryPolygons/IrisTemplate contracts; types, callbacks and mathematical helpers are shared dependencies. This is biometric processing, not a complete authorized identity service.

metadata.data_sensitivity: Biometric images, iris templates and derived measurements; protect inputs, traces and outputs.

entities.name: open-iris
entities.description: Python iris-recognition distribution providing infrared eye segmentation, geometry refinement, normalization, feature encoding, template matching and configurable inference/aggregation pipelines.
dependencies: Selected SERVER or ORB inference dependencies

entities.name: IRIS image inference command
entities.description: Command-line reference loading an input eye image with OpenCV, constructing an IRImage and invoking the default IRIS recognition pipeline through --in_img.

entities.name: IRISPipeline
entities.description: Configurable single-image iris recognition pipeline accepting IRImage input and returning environment-selected iris-template, quality, metadata and error outputs.

entities.name: TemplatesAggregationPipeline
entities.description: Configurable pipeline aligning and validating multiple iris templates and combining them into an aggregate template with image-ID metadata and error handling.

entities.name: MultiframeIrisPipeline
entities.description: Multi-frame pipeline extracting iris templates from same-eye images and passing them through template aggregation with a combined trace and output contract.

entities.name: IRIS configurable pipeline orchestrator
entities.description: Reusable pipeline base connecting configured nodes, resolving node input dependencies, invoking callbacks, managing call traces and delegating output/error handling to an environment.

metadata.deployment_warning: Configuration can locate and instantiate Python classes/callables. Accept only trusted pipeline configurations and installed code.

entities.name: PipelineCallTraceStorage
entities.description: Pipeline trace store for original inputs, intermediate/final node results and errors, with initialization, read/write and cleanup APIs and callback integration.

entities.name: IRISVisualizer
entities.description: Matplotlib-based inspection utilities plotting infrared eyes, landmarks, segmentation/noise masks, geometry, orientation, normalized iris responses and encoded templates.

entities.name: IRIS eye semantic segmentation model reference
entities.description: Model-card reference describing an infrared-eye segmentation network based on UNet++ with a MobileNetV2 encoder and scSE blocks, predicting eyeball, iris, pupil and eyelashes classes. Model weights are acquired separately by the inference adapters.

metadata.deployment_warning: Verify the separately acquired weight artifact, revision, terms and performance for the intended input population before deployment.

entities.name: TensorRTMultilabelSegmentation

entities.name: NoiseMaskUnion
entities.description: Combines equally shaped noise masks by bitwise union so downstream iris processing can exclude every flagged region.

entities.name: MultilabelSegmentationBinarization
entities.description: Thresholds segmentation prediction channels separately to produce geometry and noise masks with configurable class thresholds.

entities.name: SpecularReflectionDetection
entities.description: Thresholds infrared image intensity to identify specular-reflection regions as a noise mask.

entities.name: IrisEncoder
entities.description: Encodes complex iris filter responses into binary iris codes and validity masks by thresholding real/imaginary response and mask channels.

entities.name: BisectorsMethod
entities.description: Estimates pupil and iris centers from sampled polygon bisector intersections, supporting incomplete or noisy eye contours.
entities.capability: Bisector-based pupil and iris center estimation

entities.name: CircleFitEyeCenterMethod
entities.description: Estimates pupil and iris centers using an initial circle fit, residual-based outlier trimming and a second fit over retained contour points.

entities.name: EccentricityOffgazeEstimation
entities.description: Derives an off-gaze score from the eccentricity of pupil and iris geometry polygons.

entities.name: IrisBBoxCalculator
entities.description: Calculates the smallest iris polygon bounding box with configurable padding and image-boundary cropping.

entities.name: MomentOfArea
entities.description: Estimates eye orientation from second-order moments of the eyeball polygon for orientation-aware processing and occlusion measurement.

entities.name: OcclusionCalculator
entities.description: Measures the visible fraction of the iris using extrapolated contours, noise masks, eye orientation and estimated centers.

entities.name: PupilIrisPropertyCalculator
entities.description: Calculates pupil-to-iris diameter ratio and normalized pupil/iris center displacement from eye geometry.

entities.name: SharpnessEstimation
entities.description: Estimates normalized iris image sharpness using Laplacian variance; inadequate lighting can bias the score.

entities.name: FusionExtrapolation
entities.description: Chooses between circle-like polar extrapolation and refined ellipse fitting using contour shape statistics to complete eye geometry.

entities.name: LinearExtrapolation
entities.description: Completes pupil and iris contours through angular interpolation in polar coordinates around estimated eye centers.

entities.name: LSQEllipseFitWithRefinement
entities.description: Fits eye-contour ellipses with OpenCV and refines contour points using their distance from the fitted geometry.
entities.capability: Refined ellipse fitting for eye geometry

entities.name: ContourInterpolation
entities.description: Adds interpolated polygon contour points so consecutive samples stay within a configured maximum separation.

entities.name: ContourPointNoiseEyeballDistanceFilter
entities.description: Removes pupil/iris contour points near noise or eyeball boundaries to create a buffer against segmentation inaccuracies.

entities.name: Smoothing
entities.description: Smooths pupil and iris contours in polar coordinates using a rolling-median convolution approach around estimated centers.

entities.name: ConvFilterBank
entities.description: Applies configured image filters at probe-schema locations on a normalized iris and mask to produce complex iris and mask responses.

entities.name: GaborFilter
entities.description: Configurable two-dimensional Gabor image-filter implementation for iris texture feature extraction.

entities.name: LogGaborFilter
entities.description: Configurable two-dimensional log-Gabor filter implementation providing an alternative iris-texture frequency response.

entities.name: RegularProbeSchema
entities.description: Defines a regular sampling grid for applying an iris filter bank to normalized image coordinates.

entities.name: FragileBitRefinement
entities.description: Refines iris-response validity masks by excluding response bits outside configured reliability thresholds.

entities.name: HammingDistanceMatcher
entities.description: Compares iris templates using rotation-aware masked Hamming distance with optional normalization, separate-half matching and feature weights.

entities.name: SimpleHammingDistanceMatcher
entities.description: Compares probe/gallery iris templates through masked Hamming distance with rotation-shift and optional score-normalization settings.

entities.name: LinearNormalization
entities.description: Resamples eye-image pixels between pupil and iris contours onto a normalized iris grid using linear radial sampling.

entities.name: NonlinearNormalization
entities.description: Resamples the iris using a nonlinear radial grid and intermediate-radius parameters to produce normalized image/mask data.

entities.name: PerspectiveNormalization
entities.description: Normalizes iris image regions through local perspective transformations from trapezoids in eye geometry to rectangular output-grid regions.

entities.name: MajorityVoteAggregation
entities.description: Combines same-user iris templates through majority voting, bit-reliability weighting and consensus validity masks.

entities.name: HammingDistanceBasedAlignment
entities.description: Aligns iris templates to a selected reference by minimizing rotational Hamming distance and returns aligned templates with pairwise distances.

entities.name: TemplateIdentityFilter
entities.description: Filters or flags iris-template outliers using pairwise Hamming distances to improve same-identity consistency before aggregation.

entities.name: EyeCentersInsideImageValidator
entities.description: Checks pupil and iris centers against a configurable minimum distance from image boundaries.

entities.name: ExtrapolatedPolygonsInsideImageValidator
entities.description: Checks that a configured fraction of extrapolated pupil/iris/eyeball contour points lies inside the input image.

entities.name: Pupil2IrisPropertyValidator
entities.description: Validates pupil-to-iris measurements against configured quality thresholds and raises a targeted measurement error on failure.

entities.name: OffgazeValidator
entities.description: Rejects an estimated off-gaze score above the configured quality threshold.

entities.name: OcclusionValidator
entities.description: Checks that the measured visible iris fraction meets the configured minimum requirement.

entities.name: IsPupilInsideIrisValidator
entities.description: Validates that the pupil polygon remains contained within the iris polygon.

entities.name: PolygonsLengthValidator
entities.description: Checks pupil and iris polygon lengths against minimum geometry requirements.

entities.name: SharpnessValidator
entities.description: Rejects normalized iris images whose estimated sharpness is below a configured threshold.

entities.name: IsMaskTooSmallValidator
entities.description: Checks that an encoded iris template retains enough unmasked feature bits for reliable matching.

entities.name: AreTemplatesAggregationCompatible
entities.description: Validates compatibility of multiple iris templates before they are combined in an aggregation operation.

entities.name: ContouringAlgorithm
entities.description: Converts segmented eye raster geometry into pupil/iris/eyeball contour polygons for subsequent estimation and normalization.

exclude_groups.reason: Repository testing, documentation publishing, version checks, compliance scan and wheel release are maintenance workflows rather than iris-processing assets.

scoped_review.conclusion: Repository code is MIT, but that does not establish terms or integrity for separately downloaded model artifacts or referenced training datasets. The model entry is explicitly documentation-scoped; ONNX's download factory is not revision-pinned in source, and TensorRT deserializes a supplied engine, so deployment requires trusted pinned artifacts. YAML uses safe_load, but configured class names and callbacks are resolved through pydoc.locate and instantiated; accept only trusted configurations and installed code. Trace storage and debug output can retain raw inputs, iris templates and intermediate biometric data; isolate processing and control logging/storage/retention. Matching produces distance measurements rather than an authorization decision or proven population-wide uniqueness service. Sensitive surfaces are documented for catalog use; no biometric data was processed, external weights fetched or source code executed.

implementation_details: Abstract image/probe/matcher interfaces and Algorithm/nested Parameters/data/error plumbing
Enums, mathematical utilities and internal serialization helpers
Model training dataset citations are external references rather than bundled owned datasets
Tests and visual fixtures are evidence, not separate retained runtime assets
Routine repository CI, docs and release workflows
